metadata.summary: Internal documents indicate NVIDIA is actively evaluating AI infrastructure expansion in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, noting large‑scale data‑center opportunities in Saudi and cloud‑focused prospects in the UAE. Synthetic pipeline data estimates a $42 M Saudi AI cluster and an $18 M UAE enterprise AI platform, with power capacity and data residency identified as primary blockers respectively. The strategy brief also flags infrastructure constraints (power, cooling, connectivity, data residency) and hypothesizes that Saudi projects may be larger while UAE deployments could be faster. All findings stem from internal, fictional or synthetic sources and may not reflect actual market conditions.
